gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all issue type schemes to understand the available configurations for my projects.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of all issue type schemes with their details.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to create a new issue type scheme to better organize my project's issue types.
gold.ideal: Creates a new issue type scheme and returns the details of the created scheme.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to get the mapping of issue type schemes to projects to ensure proper issue categorization.
gold.ideal: Returns the mapping of issue type schemes to projects.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to find out which issue type scheme is assigned to my project.
gold.ideal: Returns the issue type scheme assigned to the specified project.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to assign an existing issue type scheme to my project to standardize issue types.
gold.ideal: Assigns the specified issue type scheme to the project and confirms the assignment.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to delete an obsolete issue type scheme to clean up the system.
gold.ideal: Deletes the specified issue type scheme and returns a confirmation message.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to update an existing issue type scheme to reflect changes in project requirements.
gold.ideal: Updates the specified issue type scheme and returns the updated details.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to add new issue types to an existing issue type scheme to expand its functionality.
gold.ideal: Adds the specified issue types to the issue type scheme and returns the updated scheme.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to reorder issue types in an issue type scheme to prioritize certain types.
gold.ideal: Reorders the issue types in the specified issue type scheme and returns the new order.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to remove an issue type from an issue type scheme that is no longer needed.
gold.ideal: Removes the specified issue type from the issue type scheme and confirms the removal.
